title: Friend's family sees the same beach lights
summary: Charles tells of Friend's family sees the same beach lights, about c. 2020-2021 at Cocoa Beach area, Florida, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
which I thought was super cool cuz he
was out at the beach with his family and
they saw it late at night.

plain: A witness named Charles, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, describes strange lights seen near Cocoa Beach in Florida around 2020 or 2021. He says a friend told him that he and his family were at the beach late at night and saw the same thing, which Charles thought was very cool. He tells it because it means he was not the only one to see the lights.
